title: Duyular Serisi: Bir Tat - Bir Doku - Bir Koku
author: Gülşah Yemen
description: The Series of Senses explores how sensory development expands as children begin to observe and describe the world using their five sensory organs. These abstract concepts, often hard to express in words, are made tangible, fun, and memorable. A Smell connects scents with memories and emotions. A Touch introduces the textures that shape our environment. A Taste presents the five basic tastes while celebrating the emotional and cultural connections we form with food.
original_title: Duyular Serisi: Bir Tat - Bir Doku - Bir Koku
english_title: Series of Perception: A Taste, A Touch, A Smell
